criteria.text: Ambiguous first-turn discovery is led by the customer's work or space, not a product category, without changing the canonical opening.
The canonical opening states Treejar's offer once; the remaining reply does not repeat it as a supplied-category capability list.
Every need stated in the first customer message is acknowledged or explicitly left unconfirmed; requested mobile drawers and delivery timing are not silently dropped.
The first opening asks one apt requirement clarification and folds at most one equivalent customer-name question into it.
Focused tests, repository code gates, process verification, and the protected replay check pass without re-baselining.
